newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Base price on Brazil's Banerj set at 310 mln reais.
newsitem.headline: Base price on Brazil's Banerj set at 310 mln reais.

text.p: Rio de Janeiro state bank Banerj will be sold on June 17 with its base price set at 310 million reais, said a spokeswoman for the Rio state planning secretariat.
The spokeswoman said the bid specifications for the auction were approved Wednesday by the Rio de Janeiro state privatization council and would be published on Monday.
The Rio government twice failed last year to sell the bank due to of worries on debt.
The previous minimum price was set at 480 million reais, which investors considered too high.
Last Monday, officials announced new auction rules reducing the base price to 300 million reais. The spokeswoman said the privatization council had since decided to raise the price tag a bit.
